row.reference_answer: It depends on your campus. At ERICA, group registrations are announced in the OIA notices each semester (the guide is an attachment the snapshot cannot read); otherwise book on HiKorea and apply at the immigration office yourself. At Seoul, applying in person is the rule, but the OIA runs group applications: if you are abroad, get the overseas-use Certificate of Admission, obtain the D-2 at the embassy, enter Korea and join the group residence-card application; if you are in Korea, use the domestic-use certificate and join the group visa application (change mid-August, extension mid-August to mid-September).
